summary: This PR adds a new hook to ModelAdmin for specifying custom inlines based on the request or model instance, but introduces a minor maintainability/readability defect.

issues.description: The new method get_inlines() is not documented, and its purpose is not immediately clear from its name.
The implementation of get_inlines() is a simple wrapper around get_inline_instances(), which may not be the most maintainable or readable solution.
There are no tests added to cover the new get_inlines() method, which may lead to behavioral regression risks in the future.
